note: A first singing exercise in three 2-minute blocks, each a different job (match, step away and back, sustain), with a drone as the reference instead of an instrument. Most of the text is how to use the app: the drone, the mic, the pitch line on the staff, explained once.

exercise.title: Find Do and stay on it
exercise.focus: Matching Do over a drone in C · Do-Re-Do · holding a note
exercise.why: Matching one note and holding it steady is the base every other singing skill stands on.

sections.text: Press Play below to start the drone and hum along until your voice blends with it. Then start the mic on the staff below: the staff is the five lines of music, where your pitch shows as a line. Sing {{1}} out loud on "ah" and watch your line sit on the note.

Press Play below to start the drone. Sing {{1}} for one slow breath, step up to {{2}} for the next, then come back to {{1}}. Sing the names: they help you remember each sound. Watch your line step up, then back down.
Press Play below to start the drone, now with a click. Breathe in for four clicks, then sing {{1}} on "ah" for as long as feels easy. See how flat you can keep your line to the end.
